question: As per the World Happiness Index 2023, which of the following countries secured the highest rank?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**Nepal**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **World Happiness Index** is an annual publication of the **United Nations Sustainable Development Solutions Network (UNSDSN)**.
 
• It ranks countries by how happy their citizens perceive themselves to be.
 
• **Nepal** has consistently performed well in the index when compared to its South Asian neighbors due to factors like **community ties, cultural values, and natural beauty**.
 
• The index evaluates countries on parameters such as **GDP per capita, social support, life expectancy, freedom to make life choices, generosity, and perceptions of corruption**.
 
• **Nepal** is a landlocked country in **South Asia**, situated in the Himalayas, and is famous for being home to **Mount Everest**, the world’s highest peak.
 
• Nepal's focus on **well-being, traditional values, and environmental sustainability** has contributed to its higher ranking on the index.
 
• The country's **strong social fabric, spiritual traditions, and emphasis on happiness** as a measure of success are aligned with the index's criteria.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Sri Lanka**__

 __
 
• **Sri Lanka** is an island nation in the Indian Ocean, known for its **rich history, diverse cultures, and tea plantations**.
 
• While Sri Lanka has made progress in some areas, ongoing **economic and political challenges** have impacted its happiness ranking.
 
 
 
• **Pakistan**__
 __
 
• **Pakistan** is a South Asian country bordered by India, Afghanistan, and China.
 
• Its happiness score is influenced by **socio-economic challenges, political instability, and environmental issues**.
 
 
 
• **Bangladesh**__
 
 
• **Bangladesh** is known for its **dense population, textile industry, and significant progress in human development**.
 
• Despite improvements, factors like **climate vulnerability and urban congestion** have affected its ranking.
